name: EyeofAngra
subtitle: Emergency evidence recorder
description: Open-source evidence capture. Everything stays on your device.

apps.name: EyeofAngra
apps.subtitle: Emergency evidence recorder
apps.localizedDescription:
Capture video, audio, and photos as evidence when your safety is at risk. Recording only ever starts when you tap record, an on-screen indicator shows whenever it is active, and everything stays in the app's local storage. No cloud, no accounts, no tracking.

You are responsible for complying with the recording and consent laws that apply to you.

privacy.name: NSCameraUsageDescription
privacy.usageDescription: Record evidence video and photos that you start yourself.

privacy.name: NSMicrophoneUsageDescription
privacy.usageDescription: Record evidence audio that you start yourself.
